say:1:1511408001:1.text: You visit more faithfully than those boys, Eironn and Lorsan—always flitting off like the wind!
say:1:1511408001:1.source_cn: 梅林，你又来看望我了？埃隆和洛桑那两个小子真该学学你，...
say:1:1511408001:1.male: You visit more faithfully than those boys, Eironn and Lorsan—always flitting off like the wind!
say:1:1511408001:1.female: You visit more faithfully than those boys, Eironn and Lorsan—always flitting off like the wind!

say:2:1511408002:1.text: But I can tell from your face... this isn't a social call, is it?
say:2:1511408002:1.source_cn: 让我猜猜，你这次来肯定又有什么要紧事吧？
say:2:1511408002:1.male: But I can tell from your face... this isn't a social call, is it?
say:2:1511408002:1.female: But I can tell from your face... this isn't a social call, is it?

say:4:1511408003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is searching for a child who cannot wake! He says there's a Hypogean haunting his dream.
say:4:1511408003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is searching for a child who cannot wake! He says there's a Hypogean haunting his dream.
say:4:1511408003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is searching for a child who cannot wake! She says there's a Hypogean haunting his dream.

say:5:1511408004:1.text: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.
say:5:1511408004:1.source_cn: 梦境里有恶魔？！梅林，这是怎么一回事？
say:5:1511408004:1.male: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.
say:5:1511408004:1.female: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.

say:7:1511408006:1.text: I see... No wonder <style="highlight">Lanao</style> has been asleep for days. No medicine, no herb has stirred him.

choice_prompt:8:1511408006.text: I see... No wonder <style="highlight">Lanao</style> has been asleep for days. No medicine, no herb has stirred him.
choice_prompt:8:1511408006.source_cn: 原来是这样……难怪<style=highlight>兰奥</style>那孩子一连睡了好几天，什么草药灌下去都没用。

say:9:1511408007:1.text: Yes. He must be the child you seek.
say:9:1511408007:1.source_cn: 噢，兰奥应该就是你在找的那个孩子。
say:9:1511408007:1.male: Yes. He must be the child you seek.
say:9:1511408007:1.female: Yes. He must be the child you seek.

say:10:1511408010:1.text: Lanao is usually strong and lively. This endless slumber has left his parents desperate.
say:10:1511408010:1.source_cn: 兰奥一直是个健康的小孩，这次昏睡可把他父母吓得不轻。

say:11:1511408011:0.text: I was about to contact Bryon and Arden for help, but your arrival spares me the trouble.
say:11:1511408011:0.source_cn: 我原本都打算找布莱恩联络雅顿那个老头子了，幸好你们来了...
say:11:1511408011:0.male: I was about to contact Bryon and Arden for help, but your arrival spares me the trouble.
say:11:1511408011:0.female: I was about to contact Bryon and Arden for help, but your arrival spares me the trouble.

say:12:1511408012:1.text: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.
say:12:1511408012:1.source_cn: 兰奥家就在<style=highlight>桥东侧的岸...
say:12:1511408012:1.male: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.
say:12:1511408012:1.female: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.

choice_prompt:13:1511408012.text: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.
choice_prompt:13:1511408012.source_cn: 兰奥家就在<style=highlight>桥东侧的岸边</style>，要麻烦你尽快清除他梦里的恶魔了。
choice_prompt:13:1511408012.male: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.
choice_prompt:13:1511408012.female: Lanao's home is on the <style="highlight">east bank of the bridge</style>. You must free him before the Hypogean gains more ground.

say:14:1511408013:1.text: I knew you'd say that. The Dark Forest trusts in your strength.
say:14:1511408013:1.source_cn: 当然，薄暮丛林的每个人都相信你的能力。
say:14:1511408013:1.male: I knew you'd say that. The Dark Forest trusts in your strength.
say:14:1511408013:1.female: I knew you'd say that. The Dark Forest trusts in your strength.

say:18:1511408018:0.text: Don't think I don't know about your irrigator—it nearly flattened Dyan's back! Off with you, go shut that contraption down!
say:18:1511408018:0.source_cn: 别以为我不知道，你的追踪浇灌器一直追着迪恩，差点把他的...

say:19:1511408019:0.text: W-wait, not the umbrella stick! Ow! I'll fix it, I promise!
say:19:1511408019:0.source_cn: 哇啊！我、我知道了！不要拿伞杖打我啊婆婆！

say:21:1511408020:1.text: ... He'll be busy for a while.
say:21:1511408020:1.source_cn: 看样子，达米安还会被教训很久呢。

say:22:1511408021:1.text: Let's head to the <style="highlight">east side of the bridge</style> to find <style="highlight">Lanao</style>.
say:22:1511408021:1.male: Let's head to the <style="highlight">east side of the bridge</style> to find <style="highlight">Lanao</style>.
say:22:1511408021:1.female: Let's head to the <style="highlight">east side of the bridge</style> to find <style="highlight">Lanao</style>.

choice:13:0:1.text: Don't worry, I won't let it succeed.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我不会让恶魔作祟
choice:13:0:1.male: Don't worry, I won't let it succeed.
choice:13:0:1.female: Don't worry, I won't let it succeed.

say:24:1511408014:1.text: With Merlin personally intervening, there's no doubt.
say:24:1511408014:1.source_cn: 有梅林亲自出手，他当然不会有事。
say:24:1511408014:1.male: With Merlin personally intervening, there's no doubt.
say:24:1511408014:1.female: With Merlin personally intervening, there's no doubt.

say:25:1511408015:1.text: Hah! Who said you weren't the greatest mage in all of Esperia?
say:25:1511408015:1.source_cn: 哈哈，谁让你是伊索米亚最强大的魔法师呢？
say:25:1511408015:1.male: Hah! Who said you weren't the greatest mage in all of Esperia?
say:25:1511408015:1.female: Hah! Who said you weren't the greatest mage in all of Esperia?

choice:13:2:3.text: My work is never done, is it?
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 唉，梅林真是一份累人的工作
choice:13:2:3.male: My work is never done, is it?
choice:13:2:3.female: My work is never done, is it?

say:27:1511408009:1.text: Not yet, the Hypogean must still be confined to the dream.
say:27:1511408009:1.source_cn: 这倒是还没有，想来恶魔一定还在梦中。
say:27:1511408009:1.male: Not yet, the Hypogean must still be confined to the dream.
say:27:1511408009:1.female: Not yet, the Hypogean must still be confined to the dream.

choice:8:2:3.text: Has anything strange happened near him?
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 他周围有没有出现异常？
choice:8:2:3.male: Has anything strange happened near him?
choice:8:2:3.female: Has anything strange happened near him?
